messages:
mira: quick heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 that changes how we store and rotate deploy credentials for the private/VPC agent. planning to merge during tomorrow's 09:00-10:00 PST merge window if no security blockers. can someone from sec take a look for secrets handling + kms policy? :eyes:

mira: main changes: switch from TEAM_SHARED_SECRET -> per-cluster KMS-wrapped key, add rotate_secrets job in cicd, and a small runtime change to avoid logging env vars. snippet:```diff
- REDWOOD_AGENT_KEY=plain_secret
+ REDWOOD_AGENT_KEY_KMS=/kms/keys/projects/prod/keyring/agent-key:encrypted_blob
```

samir: thanks — I can look in the next hour. initial checklist: no plaintext secrets in logs, key access limited to service account, rotation mechanism cleans old cached keys, and fallback behavior documented.

alex: FYI infra: the new per-cluster key requires an IAM binding for the agent role. I'll prepare the terraform change but won't apply until Sec signs off. also, the rotate_secrets job touches vault roles — CI will need a permission bump.

infra-bot: CI pipeline note: "rotate_secrets" job added to pipeline.yml. job will run on merge to main with workflow id rotate-2026-03. Status gating: manual_approve required for prod run.

samir: quick findings after skim: 1) KMS resource path ok, but the PR currently gives project-level decrypt to the agent service account. change to allow only key-level decrypt binding. 2) rotate_secrets job stores a temporary token in runner environment — need to switch to ephemeral short-lived token (workload identity) instead. 3) add an audit log entry for key rotation events.

mira: got it — i'll update the PR: scope the iam binding, swap token for workload identity, and add an audit log hook. do you want the rotate job to write events to ops-log or security-log?

samir: write rotation events to security-log with a structured payload (cluster, rotation_id, rotated_by). please do not include any ciphertext in logs.

alex: once samir approves, i'm good to apply infra change in the next maintenance slot. if anyone objects to merge tomorrow 09:00 PST call it out now.

mira: updated branch with the iam/key scoping change and replaced runner token with short-lived SA impersonation. removed accidental debug echo in startup script. PTAL @samir.

security-bot: automated scan: no plaintext secrets detected in committed files. policy-scan: KMS-binding: WARN (key-level binding recommended).

samir: rechecked — looks much better. two minor asks: add a unit test for the rotate job to assert token expiry <= 10m, and include a fallback path doc snippet for offline cluster recoveries. after that, :+1: from me.

mira: added test and a short recovery note under docs/private-deploy/rotation.md. merging to staging now. i'll hold prod merge until alex confirms infra apply. thanks! :rocket:
